> [!summary]
> Positional encodings determine how models reason about order. Good schemes train short but generalise to longer contexts.

- Absolute/learned: add a learned vector per position; simple, weak extrapolation.
- Relative position bias: learn bias as a function of pairwise distance; stable encoders.
- [RoPE](/thoughts/RoPE): rotate Q/K in complex plane; inner products encode relative offsets; robust long-range behavior (Su et al., 2023).
- ALiBi: add linear distance penalties to attention logits, inducing recency bias that extends context without re-training (Press et al., 2022).

### RoPE scaling to extend context

- NTK-aware scaling: adjust RoPE frequency base to stretch periods for longer contexts.
- YaRN: segment and rescale RoPE dims; efficient extension with small fine-tune (Peng et al., 2023).
- LongRoPE: search-guided rescaling with progressive training to reach 1M-2M+ tokens (Ding et al., 2024).

See also: [MLA](/lectures/3/quantisation-basics#multi-latent-attention) for architectural KV reduction complementary to PE scaling.
